FINISH_HOLIDAY_13_DESC: Want a plant that can pierce through zombies while also staying away from any dangerous bites? Cactus' got you covered! Complete Holiday Mashup Day 13!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_16_DESC: Jalapeno incinerates a whole lane of zombies in one single blast! Complete Holiday Mashup Day 16!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_18_DESC: Out-party the festive Gargantuars of Holiday Mashup Day 18 and earn a Steam Ages Key!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_19_DESC: Blooming Heart defeats zombies with ever-increasing projectile damage! Complete Holiday Mashup Day 19!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_1_DESC: Use your Holiday Mashup Key to unlock the calamitous celebrations of Holiday Mashup!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_20_DESC: THE CALAMITY CALENDAR: Frolic in the frivolities of this never-ending celebration! Complete Holiday Mashup Day 20!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_24_DESC: Triumph over ZCorp's newest technological terror on Holiday Mashup Day 24!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_26_DESC: Sweet Potato's as sweet as can be, and grouping zombies up is her specialty! Complete Holiday Mashup Day 26!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_28_DESC: Boingsetta rids your lawn of pesky obstacles and critters! Complete Holiday Mashup Day 28!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_2_DESC: Sap-fling sticks the floor up, it's a complete crowd staller! Complete Holiday Mashup Day 2!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_30_DESC: Outsmart the outstanding calculations of Professor Brainstorm on Holiday Mashup Day 30!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_31_DESC: Blast zombies with the continously growing Strawburst! Complete Holiday Mashup Day 31!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_36_DESC: Eradicate the erroneous error of Dr. Zomboss' calculations on Holiday Mashup Day 36!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_39_DESC: Jack O' Lantern releases a burst of fire over a short range that does massive damage! Complete Holiday Mashup Day 39!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_42_DESC: Relieve some stress off Dr. Zomboss' back by taking care of his layabout nephew on the battle of Day 42!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_44_DESC: Caulipower randomly hypnotizes foes to fight on your behalf! Complete Holiday Mashup Day 44!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_48_DESC: Rendezvous with the rambunctious Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this wracking wrap-up on Holiday Mashup Day 48!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_4_DESC: Ghost Pepper gives all zombies around her the creeps! Complete Holiday Mashup Day 4!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_6_DESC: Mush the multiplying menace that is Impfinity on Holiday Mashup Day 6!
FINISH_HOLIDAY_9_DESC: Dandelion will cover his up lane, his forward lane, and his down lane using his trusty explosive seeds! Complete Holiday Mashup Day 9!
FINISH_HOLLOWS_12_DESC: Get rid of your cold shoulders for an encounter with the tribal chief! Complete Hypothermic Hollows Day 12!
FINISH_HOLLOWS_17_DESC: ABSOLUTE ZERO PLATEAU:  Take your frigid fights to the polar extreme! Complete Hypothermic Hollows Day 17!
FINISH_HOLLOWS_20_DESC: Save the day with an unprecedented alliance to send the Tuskmaster back into extinction! Complete Hypothermic Hollows Day 20!
FINISH_HOLLOWS_3_DESC: Flameweed warms up plants and burns zombies under them rapidly, including flying foes. You'll want it in your coal-lection! Complete Hypothermic Hollows Day 3!
FINISH_ICEAGE_11_DESC: Hold the line, or better yet, push 'em back! Chard Guard is on the case. Complete Frostbite Caves Day 11!
FINISH_ICEAGE_16_DESC: Attack the abominable Gargantuar of Frostbite Caves Day 16 to earn a sector-shifting Lost City Key!
FINISH_ICEAGE_19_DESC: Need to stun some zombies in place for a while? Stunion is ON IT! Complete Frostbite Caves Day 19!
FINISH_ICEAGE_1_DESC: Freezing wind got you down? Hot Potato breaks the ice! Complete Frostbite Caves Day 1!
FINISH_ICEAGE_20_DESC: ICEBOUND BATTLEGROUND! Fracture frigid zombies in this ongoing glacial gambit! Complete Frostbite Caves Day 20!
FINISH_ICEAGE_26_DESC: Rotobaga flies, floats and fires in four fabulous directions! Complete Frostbite Caves Day 26.
FINISH_ICEAGE_30_DESC: Confound the corrupt Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this cryogenic conflict on Frostbite Caves Day 30!
FINISH_ICEAGE_33_DESC: WEATHER REPORT: There is an approaching kalestorm, Hurrikale being the likely culprit. Complete Frostbite Caves Day 33!
FINISH_ICEAGE_35_DESC: Your brain tasty for Sloth Gargantuar. But brain make you alive! Brain no give to Sloth Gargantuar! Overcome the onslaught on Frostbite Caves Day 35!
FINISH_ICEAGE_35_TITLE: Overcome the onslaught in Frostbite Caves Expansion!
FINISH_ICEAGE_37_DESC: Fire Peashooter's searing spheres are the light at the end of the Frostbite tunnel! Complete Frostbite Caves Day 37!
FINISH_ICEAGE_40_DESC: Fur make Dr. Zomboss sneeze. New boss no have real fur! Make Dr. Zomboss dangerous! Complete Frostbite Caves Day 40!
FINISH_ICEAGE_6_DESC: Fight ice with fire. Pepper-pult melts ice and lobs hot blobs over obstacles! Complete Frostbite Caves Day 6!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_10_DESC: The best offense is a good defense? How about both! Endurian blocks AND damages foes! Complete Lost City Day 10!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_16_DESC: Dash the dastardly Gargantuar of Lost City Day 16 to earn an era-expanding Neon Mixtape Tour Key!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_19_DESC: Stallia slows down zombies with a burst of fragrant perfume! Complete Lost City Day 19!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_1_DESC: Red Stingers shoot powerfully close to home and become more defensive further away! Complete Lost City Day 1!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_20_DESC: TEMPLE OF BLOOM! Eradicate exploring zombies in this perpetual party of botanical battle! Complete Lost City Day 20!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_26_DESC: Gold Leaf turns regular boring tiles into exciting sun-generating Gold Tiles! Complete Lost City Day 26!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_32_DESC: Pester the pernicious Dr. Zomboss in the adventurous arena of Lost City Day 32!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_35_DESC: To Lava Guava, cremating the dead isn't some sort of ancient ritual - it's just Tuesday. Complete Lost City Night 35!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_37_DESC: Step over years of archeological progress and prevent the discovery of that brain you’re carrying in your skull! Overcome the onslaught on Lost City Night 37!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_37_TITLE: Overcome the onslaught in Lost City Expansion!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_38_DESC: Dazey Chain's buds take their time to blossom, but they never fail to stun zombies every step of the way! Complete Lost City Night 38!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_42_DESC: With utter lack of taste, Dr. Zomboss decided to use ancient sculptures in his latest build! Teach him a lesson on Lost City Night 42!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_6_DESC: A.K.E.E. lobs shots that bounce off of several foes down a lane. Heads up, zombies! Complete Lost City Day 6!
FINISH_MARKET_10_DESC: Chef Gargantuars are serving up trouble! Complete Lunar Rainbow Market Night 10!
FINISH_MARKET_12_DESC: Iris can create mystical birds to keep flocks of zombies away while stalling them too. You'd feather believe it! Complete Lunar Rainbow Market Night 12!
FINISH_MARKET_17_DESC: DISCONNECTED TRADE CENTER: Explore the seemingly never-ending stretches of the market while putting your heart in the cards. Complete Lunar Rainbow Market Night 17!
FINISH_MARKET_20_DESC: One final obstacle remains to save the market. It likes to chug oil and kick grass, and it's all out of oil. Complete Lunar Rainbow Market Night 20!
FINISH_MARKET_3_DESC: Begonia fires spears of ice and fire that can combo together for some serious petal power! Complete Lunar Rainbow Market Night 3!
FINISH_MARKET_6_DESC: Cheese Strawberry lobs delectable cheese that reduces zombie eating speed. It doesn't get cheddar than that! Complete Lunar Rainbow Market Night 6!
FINISH_MODERN_10_DESC: Poison zombies with the shadowy toxicity of Shadow-shroom! Complete Modern Day Day 10!
FINISH_MODERN_16_DESC: Upbraid the up-to-date Gargantuars of Modern Day Day 16, to earn a shiny Holiday Mashup Key!
FINISH_MODERN_17_DESC: Fling explosive nuggets at hungry zombies with Dusk-Lobber! Complete Modern Day Day 17!
FINISH_MODERN_1_DESC: Boost shadow plants with the lunar lunacy of Moonflower! Complete Modern Day Day 1!
FINISH_MODERN_20_DESC: HIGHWAY TO THE DANGER ROOM! Tangle with temporal titans in this neverending nexus! Complete Modern Day Day 20!
FINISH_MODERN_20_TITLE: Unlock Highway to the Danger Room!
FINISH_MODERN_23_DESC: Drag zombies to their deserved doom with the Grimrose! Complete Modern Day Day 23!
FINISH_MODERN_34_DESC: Defy the devilish Dr. Zomboss and earn your reward in the climactic clash of Modern Day Day 34!
FINISH_MODERN_40_DESC: Noctarine's dark boom spells modern zombie doom, spreading coarse fumes and bringing shady plants to bloom! Complete Modern Day Day 40!
FINISH_MODERN_42_DESC: An amalgamation of the eras try to cease your lawful mission! You must persevere! Complete Modern Day Day 42!
FINISH_MODERN_42_TITLE: Overcome the onslaught in Modern Day Expansion!
FINISH_MODERN_43_DESC: When zombies pinch Murkadamia Nut, he'll pinch back! Complete Modern Day Day 43!
FINISH_MODERN_46_DESC: Make all zombies afraid of their own shadows with Shadow Peashooter! Complete Modern Day Day 46!
FINISH_MODERN_4_DESC: Deal major slaps with the shadow Nightshade! Complete Modern Day Day 4!
FINISH_MODERN_50_DESC: It all comes down to this! Shatter the abhorrent plans of Dr. Zomboss and crush his final stand on Modern Day Day 50!
FINISH_PIRATE_11_DESC: BOOM! Clear entire groups of zombies with each explosive shot from Coconut Cannon! Complete Pirate Seas Day 11!
FINISH_PIRATE_14_DESC: Threepeater shoots down three lanes at once to triple your offensive firepower! Complete Pirate Seas Day 14!
FINISH_PIRATE_18_DESC: Spikerock: Strong enough to stand up to a Gargantuar, sharp enough to de-feet zombies! Complete Pirate Seas Day 18!
FINISH_PIRATE_1_DESC: Can Kernel-pult deal damage AND stun zombies? You'd butter believe it! Complete Pirate Seas Day 1!
FINISH_PIRATE_21_DESC: Extra Seed Slot: Carry more plants into the fray! More seed slots mean more options! Complete Pirate Seas Day 21!
FINISH_PIRATE_24_DESC: Cherry Bomb's overwhelming blast fries whole groups of foes across lanes! Complete Pirate Seas Day 24!
FINISH_PIRATE_25_DESC: Hammer the hateful Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this saltwater scrap on Pirate Seas Day 25!
FINISH_PIRATE_27_DESC: Cover your bases and catapult apples on pirates in three adjacent lanes with Apple Mortar! Complete Pirate Seas Day 27!
FINISH_PIRATE_29_DESC: Take down Gargantuars and feed 'em to the fishes! Overcome the onslaught on Pirate Seas Day 29!
FINISH_PIRATE_29_TITLE: Overcome the onslaught in Pirate Seas Expansion!
FINISH_PIRATE_31_DESC: Iceweed makes the planks even more cumbersome to cross! Complete Pirate Seas Day 31!
FINISH_PIRATE_35_DESC: Prove that you're the better captain of a ship! Complete Pirate Seas Day 35!
FINISH_PIRATE_3_DESC: Heat things up with Snapdragon's fiery attacks that hit multiple lanes at a time! Complete Pirate Seas Day 3!
FINISH_PIRATE_4_DESC: DEAD MAN'S BOOTY! Endless adventures on the high seas await your command! Complete Pirate Seas Day 4!
FINISH_PIRATE_6_DESC: Damage zombies and bust barrels with the indomitable Spikeweed! Complete Pirate Seas Day 6!
FINISH_PIRATE_8_DESC: Smash the appalling Gargantuar of Pirate Seas Day 8 to earn a zone-hopping Wild West Key!
FINISH_PIRATE_9_DESC: Swashbuckler got you on the ropes? Use Spring Bean to knock 'em back to Davy Jones' locker! Complete Pirate Seas Day 9!
FINISH_SKYCITY_12_DESC: Crash the Colonel Gargantuar back to earth and get one step closer to who's behind this aggravated, aerial activity! Complete Assault Airspace Day 12!
FINISH_SKYCITY_13_DESC: Carefully coordinated to target the right Zombies, the pilots in the P-15 Peagle Pod are like peas in a pod- figuratively AND literally! Complete Assault Airspace Day 13!
FINISH_SKYCITY_15_DESC: Need damage in a pinch, but don't have clouds nearby? Dazzle and damage the dead with Nispaereo's dance! Complete Assault Airspace Day 15!
FINISH_SKYCITY_18_DESC: Able to rapid-fire normal peas or send a mega pea for fortified foes, Gatling Pea is back just in time for war! Complete Assault Airspace Day 18!
FINISH_SKYCITY_1_DESC: Attack Zombies in 3 lanes with the air-adapted Acesparagus! Complete Assault Airspace Day 1!
FINISH_SKYCITY_25_DESC: Crush the Camotron Vulture Fighter and any chance of a "Plan C," too! Complete Assault Airspace Day 25!
FINISH_SKYCITY_4_DESC: Receiving projectiles like mail? Return to sender with Puffapple's reflective prowess! Complete Assault Airspace Day 4!
FINISH_SKYCITY_6_DESC: Acquire aerial apprentice Saucer Squash and abduct weaker Zombies while stunning others in range! Complete Assault Airspace Day 6!
FINISH_STEAM_11_DESC: Lily of Alchemy is sure to give those zombies what for using her lobbed poisonous projectiles! Complete Steam Ages, Day 11!
FINISH_STEAM_13_DESC: A better pay is always the better way. Complete Steam Ages, Day 13 and get paid more for your hard work of keeping those lawnmowers in place!
FINISH_STEAM_14_DESC: Berry Blaster can shoot out bouncing berries that can do some damage before exploding! Complete Steam Ages, Day 14!
FINISH_STEAM_16_DESC: Put a stop to the nefarious plot of Foreman Gargantuar at Day 16 of Steam Ages and earn yourself a dashing World Key!
FINISH_STEAM_18_DESC: Pea-nut fights from afar, and survives in close quarters encounters! Complete Steam Ages, Day 18!
FINISH_STEAM_1_DESC: Fight off Labor Zombies from all sides and unlock the dazzling Cattail! Complete Steam Ages, Day 1!
FINISH_STEAM_20_DESC: BRAIN DRAIN FACTORY: Forge your way through the mass-produced madness! Complete Steam Ages, Day 20!
FINISH_STEAM_22_DESC: Maypop Mechanic's the best at multitasking, she'll help you stay protected in all directions! Complete Steam Ages, Day 22!
FINISH_STEAM_25_DESC: Lotus Root fires lotus of bubbles to cover a wide area, or annihilate a zombie point blank: he roots for you! Complete Steam Ages, Day 25!
FINISH_STEAM_32_DESC: Unwind the unyieliding Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this gear-grinding grapple on Steam Ages, Day 32!
FINISH_STEAM_4_DESC: Harsh winds that can stun zombies all throughout the lane may prove useful after you complete Steam Ages, Day 4!
FIREPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}has a chance to shoot a plasma pea
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost 
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Fire Peashooter knows that what she does looks exciting. But working with an open flame is serious and, more importantly, dangerous business.  That's why, in her spare time, she talks to children about the importance of fire safety. "I'm a trained professional," she explains. "Don't try this at home, kids."
FIREPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Fire Peashooters shoot flaming peas down the lane.
FIREPEASHOOTER_PLANTFOOD: Throws a line of flame down the lane, damaging all zombies in it.
FIREPEASHOOTER_TOOLTIP: Shoots flaming peas and warms nearby plants
FORCE_RESTORE_PURCHASES_BODY: This item has been purchased before. Restore Purchases will allow you to claim all of your past purchases in any profile.
FROZENPEAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}attack slows down when at half health

{FLAVOR}Frozen Pear is a tourist by heart, and will take any opportunity she can to visit new worlds. As such, she will frequently update the viewers of her vlog constantly whenever she can. "This place is so much more relaxing compared to the last place I went to," she says in her most recent upload. "There were so many scary zombies there! Especially that one on the wheelchair, I still have nightmares of that one." She shivers fearfully. "I'm just glad here has all these crazy holidays they love to celebrate. And I want you guys to guess my favorite in the replies!"
FROZENPEAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Frozen Pears can release impact waves that damage, freeze, and chill all nearby zombies when they get close.
FROZENPEAR_TOOLTIP: Blocks zombies while freezing them in a 3x3 area
FUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"I think of myself as a pretty confident shroom and an all-around fungi," says Fume-shroom. "But sometimes, when I'm eating Plant Food, I hear them chuckling. I hear them calling me 'Balloon-shroom'. I don't think they know how much that hurts."
FUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Fume-shrooms shoot fumes that damage all zombies in an area.
FUMESHROOM_TOOLTIP: Shoots fumes that can damage all zombies in an area
GAMECENTER_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: You must connect to Game Center outside the PvZ2 app to access achievements and leaderboards.
GARLIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}on being eaten
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can't affect mechanical zombies

{FLAVOR}Good against zombies, as well as proof against any vampires who might accidentally wander by.
GARLIC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Garlic diverts zombies into other lanes.
GATLING_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire when charged

{FLAVOR}A plant with a legendary reputation that preceeds him, there have been murmurs on if he found his way into the compost in some great battle or if he's some fictional character made to inspire young sprouts. There have even been some to don the mantle and attempt to continue the legacy. The truth of what has become of him is about as simple as Gatling Pea himself: he found himself in a REALLY high position.
GATLING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gatling Pea shoots in bursts of four. When charged, Gatling Pea can be tapped on to fire a single giant pea.
GATLING_TOOLTIP: Tap on Gatling Pea when charged to fire a giant pea
GEMS_STORE_TEXT: Need more gems? Choose a package below.
GHOSTPEPPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates when zombie is close
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}targets zombies that are 2 tiles ahead or behind it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}You might not know it looking at her, but Ghost Pepper didn't always wear that white sheet everywhere she went. She first put it on as a lark for a Halloween party one year. Everyone else had these elaborate costumes, and she thought it would be funny to dress like a plain ol' ghost. But she fell in love with that costume. It spoke to her. She'd found her calling.
GHOSTPEPPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ghost Peppers haunt zombies that pass by and explode after a limited time.
GHOSTPEPPER_TOOLTIP: Haunts all zombies that pass by and explodes after a limited time
GLOOMVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powers shadow plants inside them

{FLAVOR}Gloom Vine's gloomy exterior shouldn't be seen as implying a gloomy interior. His interior is gloomy, but for complicated personal reasons that go way back.
GLOOMVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gloom Vines power individual shadow plants and shoot zombie-damaging gloom in eight directions.
GLOOMVINE_TOOLTIP: Shoots in 8 directions and shadow-boosts a plant inside of it
GOLDBLOOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"Your botanists were so preoccupied with whether they could," says Gold Bloom, about nothing and to nobody in particular, "they didn't stop to think if they should."
GOLDBLOOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gold Blooms produce a burst of sun all at once.
GOLDBLOOM_TOOLTIP: Gives an instant burst of sun
GOLDLEAF_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"For a small initial investment, you too can generate huge sun," says Gold Leaf. She’s a firm believer in solar markets.
GOLDLEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gold Leaves create a Gold Tile on planting.
GOOGLE_PLAY_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: You must connect to Google Play to access achievements and leaderboards.
GOT_A_POWERUP: You got a new POWER UP!
GRANT_WORLDKEYS_COMPLETIONIST_BODY_TEXT: You already have all your keys!
GRANT_WORLDKEYS_MIDPLAYER_BODY_TEXT: You just got keys for all the worlds! Check them out!
GRANT_WORLDKEYS_NEWPLAYER_BODY_TEXT: You shouldn't be seeing this message, it is only for older players.
GRANT_WORLDKEYS_TITLE_TEXT: Hey, time traveler! Here’s all the world keys.
GRAPESHOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"Spa-BOOM!" enthuses Grapeshot. "You like that? I got a million of 'em! Wa-POW!  Buh-BLAM! Za-... um... Ker-... hmmm... Okay, I guess I've only got the three."
GRAPESHOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grapeshots explode and scatter bouncing projectiles in eight directions.
GRAVEBUSTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}removes graves and varying objects

{FLAVOR}He may appear spiky or ill-tempered, but Grave Buster just wants to give you a big hug. Unless you're a puppy. He's terrified of those.
GRAVEBUSTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grave Busters consume graves they're planted on.
GRAVEBUSTER_TOOLTIP: Plant it on a grave to remove the grave
GREATZUCCHINI_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire when charged
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}zombies with less than 200 health die instead
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage, lowers speed of zombies that can't be transformed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}The Great Zucchini has been facing a bit of a culture shock ever since making the move from his old job. "The exchange rate for Sun is utterly confusing, Zombies try to pull their tricks whenever they can, and dear me- Nobody waits their turn here!" For being a smarty plant, he's got a lot of learning to do.
GREATZUCCHINI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The Great Zucchini can be tapped on to release the magic of the Basic Zombie tarot card, transforming zombies into basics.
GREATZUCCHINI_TOOLTIP: Tap when charged to transform zombies into basics
GRID_IS_YOURS_BOOSTTILE3_DESCRIPTION: Disperse {COUNT} three-use Boost Tile every {TIME} seconds!
GRID_IS_YOURS_BOOSTTILE_DESCRIPTION: Disperse {COUNT} single-use Boost Tiles every {TIME} seconds!
GRID_IS_YOURS_PFTOMBSTONE_DESCRIPTION: Spawn {COUNT} Plant Food Gravestone every {TIME} seconds!
GRIMROSE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powered Grimroses can drag 3 zombies before expiring

{FLAVOR}"When you think about it, the proper place for a zombie is in the ground," says Grimrose. "So, really, I'm just expediting the process."
GRIMROSE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grimroses are shadow plants that behave like landbound Tangle Kelps, dragging zombies into the dirt.
GUACODILE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}plant is lost after rushing attack
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on water

{FLAVOR}Ask Guacodile to tell you a little bit about himself and he'll give you a wry smile. "I'm a Guacodile. I've got a bite like a bear trap. I spit rock-hard pits with a force, speed and accuracy envied by every plant on the battlefield. Heck, I've been known to walk on water. I'm pretty much the whole enchilada." Yeah, the guy is a bit of a braggart but he’s good at what he does.
GUACODILE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Guacodiles fire seeds from a distance. When attacked they will rush off the lawn biting any zombies they encounter.
GUACODILE_TOOLTIP: Shoots seeds, will rush all zombies ahead of him when attacked
GUMNUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stronger zombies form stronger barriers
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}best used against Gargantuars & Football Mechs

{FLAVOR}"I only chew ham-flavored gum," exudes Gumnut. "Ham and salt."
GUMNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gumnuts pop sticky gum onto zombies, pinning them in place and causing them to block other zombies behind them.
HEADBUTTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can attack ahead or behind

{FLAVOR}Headbutter Lettuce was recently outed during a "truth or dare" game gone wrong. The entire plant world is still recovering from the shambles that Headbutter Lettuce's dark secret has left it in. "You won't believe it," he said, "This isn't butter. It's margarine."
HEADBUTTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Headbutter Lettuces bash zombies in front and behind while occasionally buttering zombies.
HEATHSEEKER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can target from anywhere on the lawn

{FLAVOR}Heath Seekers have always believed that the shortest distance between two points is an elaborately curved path that passes through several zombies and also looks pretty. Needless to say, they're struggling in geometry class.
HEATHSEEKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Heath Seekers are instant-use plants that burst into a storm of homing, piercing darts.
HEATHSEEKER_TOOLTIP: Storms out a group of homing darts
HOCUS_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"Observe," says Hocus Crocus. "Have I anything up my sleeve? Do I even have sleeves? No? Prepare, then, to have your quaint and old-fashioned notions of spatial location SHATTERED FOREVER!!!"
HOCUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hocus Crocuses use slick sleight-of-petal chicanery to magic zombies close to your home all the way back to the rightmost part of the lawn.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can't be eaten by zombies
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}crushed by rolling zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Having dedicated his sprout years to martial arts, Flameweed spent many decades perfecting his techniques atop of Tibet's chilling mountains. Any method to keep his opponents hot on their feet or on their toes, he knows it. He would've made it to the top of his class, had it been not for Has-hands-weed. There's still a bit of a grudge.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Flameweeds burn zombies that walk over them and unlike other weeds, can attack flying zombies.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_PLANTFOOD: Scorches two tiles to the left and right of himself, dealing massive damage.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_TOOLTIP: Damages and ashes zombies that step on it
HOLLYKNIGHT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire, can fire up to 3 barriers
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}projectile knocks back, does damage, leaves barrier on empty tiles
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks flying zombies

{FLAVOR}Holly Barrier would like to advise folks not to eat his berries. "It's rude to eat somebody's berries without asking," he says. "In addition, they are highly toxic."
HOLLYKNIGHT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Holly Barrier deals damage to zombies attacking him, and can launch 3 prickly barrier leaves to knock back and damage zombies.
HOLLYKNIGHT_TOOLTIP: Damages attacking zombies, tap to launch barriers
HOLONUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}regenerates health over time

{FLAVOR}As a young nut he spent way too much time standing between two mirrors and trying to look into infinity.
HOLONUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Infi-nuts are weaker than Wall-nuts, but they can regain health over time.
HOLONUT_TOOLTIP: A weaker Wall-nut that regains health over time
HOMINGTHISTLE_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Don't even think about trying to pull one over on Homing Thistle. He's got a bead on you. He sees right through your facade. It's like he has a laser beam ... aimed at your soul.
HOMINGTHISTLE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Homing Thistles fire seeking shots at targets that are the closest to home.
HOMINGTHISTLE_TOOLTIP: Attacks farthest left target in any lane
HORSEBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}rows adjacent to Peagle Pod
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}The P-15 Peagle Pod model is equipped with the highest quality Phloem cell engineering featuring the Chlorophyll model 24 Fuselage, Bioactive Propulsion Wings, Empennage made of a Wooden Vertical Stabilizer and 2 Wooden Horizontal Stabilizers for Pitch firing stability. Internal mechanisms include the Hazelnut Ailerons and Elevators, the newest Epidermis Oxygen Based Rudder, Stem Flaps, 2 Pressurized Oak Slats, Starch Speed Brakes that double as Air Brakes, Protein Canards and Proteolysis Based Nose and Main Gear. Other features include Pisum sativum Shock Absorbers, Retraction Mechanism, Photosynthesis Jet Engines and Afterburners, an Oak Exhaust Nozzle, and an Ejection Seat. 3 Pea Pilots included.
HORSEBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: P-15 Peagle Pod sends out commandos to attack zombies in a nearby area.
HORSEBEAN_TOOLTIP: Deals heavy damage to zombies in surrounding lanes
HOTDATEATTRACTION: Use Hot Date's Plant Food effect to attract
HOTDATE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}explosion damage pierces through zombie armor
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Hot Date's a charmer. He's polite, well-read, has lots of interesting opinions, and practices active listening. Zombies line up around the block to be incinerated by him.
HOTDATE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hot Dates attract zombies from lanes above and below them, and then unleash a lane of flame when they're eaten.
HOTPOTATO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}melts an ice block or octopus

{FLAVOR}How does Hot Potato stay so positive and even-peeled all the time? Yoga, that’s how. She never misses a class. Also, regular meditation. It's the only way she can handle the hard work of fighting zombies, day in and day out, without melting down.
HOTPOTATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hot Potatoes melt the ice blocks or octopi they’re planted on.
HOTPOTATO_TOOLTIP: Plant it on ice blocks and octopi to melt them
HURRIKALE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}chills affected zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blows away flying zombies in lane

{FLAVOR}You could say Hurrikale is a "blow hard" in the truest sense of the phrase. He is the first chair trombonist in the Biennial Philharmonic Orchestra. He is also proficient in the trumpet, saxophone and the tuba. But man o' man, you should really see him on the flugelhorn. Dude absolutely kills it.
HURRIKALE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hurrikales push back all zombies in their lane with a chilling wind.
HURRIKALE_TOOLTIP: Blows a chilling wind that pushes back zombies in lane
HYPNOSHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten

{FLAVOR}Hypno-shroom has no trouble persuading zombies to fight on behalf of the plants. But he has yet to convince one to cluck like a chicken. "One day," he says. "One day."
HYPNOSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: When zombies eat Hypno-shrooms, they will turn around and fight for you.
HYPNOSHROOM_TOOLTIP: Makes a zombie fight for you
ICEBLOOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}weak zombies in 3x3 area are iceblocked when defeated

{FLAVOR}Even though Ice Bloom got the freezing zombies gig from her old college roommate, Ice-shroom, after he retired from the zombie-fighting life, she insisted that what she's doing with her role on the battlefield is totally different. She's not just some imposter or a sub-standard replacement, darn it! She's her own plant, and she wishes her peers would see her that way.
ICEBLOOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ice Blooms freeze, chill, and damage all zombies on the board, and more so in a 3x3 area around where they’re planted.
ICEBLOOM_TOOLTIP: Freezes all zombies on the lawn, turns weak ones into defensive ice blocks
ICEBURG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact

{FLAVOR}Don't get lost staring into Iceberg's adorably cute eyes. If you do, it will be your last step... but only if you're a zombie.
ICEBURG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Iceberg Lettuces freeze a zombie when stepped on.
ICEBURG_PLANTFOOD: Flash freezes all zombies on the lawn.
ICEBURG_TOOLTIP: Freezes zombies that step on it, and extinguishes flames
ICEWEED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can't be eaten by zombies
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}crushed by rolling zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}main attack becomes more powerful after being fed Plant Food

{FLAVOR}Iceweed is excited to get the call-up to the big leagues and can't wait to start refrigerating zombies whilst inflicting damage on them. He insisted we say "whilst."
ICEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Iceweeds damage and chill zombies that walk over them.
ICEWEED_TOOLTIP: Damages and chills zombies that step on it
ICYCURRANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}area effect (icy fence)

{FLAVOR}The cold isn't why Icy Currant is constantly shivering with a worried look on it's face. No, rather, it has suffered countless acts of trauma over the years. Electric Currant's been giving him the cold shoulder, he's broken multiple codes of conduct at the workplace, and right before he was planned to enter the fray, he got blown up in a freak accident. It's a slow recovery...
ICYCURRANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Icy Currants create icy fences between ones planted on the same row or column.
IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_INTRO_TEXT: We have detected multiple different identities associated with you. On the following screen please review the data with each identity and select which one you would like to proceed with.
IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_SAVE_FAILURE: Identity save has failed. Please check your internet connection and try again.
IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_WARNING_TEXT: Are you sure you would like to proceed with this identity? This will be the permanent identity associated with you. All Arena Winstreak, Arena League, and Adventure progress will be lost on other identities.
IMITATER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can imitate any other plant 

{FLAVOR}Having studied French Theater at Julienne, the Imitater went to the streets with his art, and has perfected his technique he calls "Potato stuck in a box."
IMITATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Imitaters let you use two of the same plant during a level!
IMITATER_PLANTFOOD: Performs Plant Food effect of the plant it's imitating.
IMITATER_TOOLTIP: Lets you have two of the same plant
IMPPEAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten

{FLAVOR}Imp Pear impairs zombies. Of course, Imps don’t appreciate this characterization, but who cares?
IMPPEAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: When zombies eat Imp Pears, they become Imps. When Imps eat Imp Pears, they are destroyed, releasing stunning gas.
INFERNO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Inferno doesn't feel like he gets enough credit. "Of course I burn zombies," he fumes. "That's a given. But what about how I sweep them down the lane through the sheer force of hot air? Where's my prize for that?"
INFERNO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Infernos swirl up devastating fire tornados that sweep zombies back, burning and damaging them.
INFERNO_TOOLTIP: Shoots tornadoes that burn and push back zombies
INFLICT_CONDITION_ASH_DESC: Use Cherry Bombs, Lightning Reeds, Jalapenos and more to incinerate ghastly ghouls!
INFLICT_CONDITION_BUTTERED_DESC: That's it. Just butter them. Why? Just because!
INFLICT_CONDITION_DELAY_COUNT_LABEL: Butter, Sap or Stall Zombies {ACTIONS_LEFT} Times!
INFLICT_CONDITION_DELAY_DESC: Use Stunions, Stallias, Kernel-pult, and more to delay the advancement of the horde!
INFLICT_CONDITION_ELECTROCUTE_DESC: Use Lightning Reeds, Electric Blueberries and more to zap zealous zombies!
INFLICT_CONDITION_KNOCKBACK_DESC: Use Primal Peashooter, Chard Guard, Hurrikale and more to bounce back pesky zombies!
INFLICT_CONDITION_REFRIGERATE_DESC: Use Winter Melons, Iceberg Lettuce, Snow Peas and more to chill, freeze and otherwise cool down the undead!
INFLICT_CONDITION_STALLED_DESC: Use Stallias, Dazey Chains, and more to stall the advancement of the horde!
INFLICT_CONDITION_SUNBEANED_DESC: Use Solar Tomatoes and Sun Beans to make the horde cough up some extra sun!
INKBLOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fog makes zombies allergic to buffs
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}remove debuffs from nearby plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}uses buffs and debuffs to upgrade into 2 different ranks, temporarily increases damage and size of fog

{FLAVOR}Story goes of a deeply ingrained mushroom that stood peacefully in a forest. Each and every day, the mushroom watched as a group of frolicking plants were having fun dancing and singing with each other. Wanting to join them in harmony, the mushroom wished for a way to unroot itself... until one day, her wish was met in an unexpected and hazy way.
INKBLOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Haze-shroom sneezes fog that becomes stronger the more buffs it steals.
INKBLOT_TOOLTIP: Sneezes fog that becomes stronger the more buffs it steals
INTENSIVECARROT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"How do I revive defeated plants?" asks Intensive Carrot. "In a word: vitamins. Vitamins and sorcery."
INTENSIVECARROT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Intensive Carrots bring eaten plants back to life.
INTENSIVECARROT_TOOLTIP: Brings eaten plants back to life
JACKOLANTERN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fire recharges over time
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}"Boo! Mwah-ha-ha-haaaaah," opines Jack O' Lantern. Oh, yes. Things and stuff are scheduled to be seriously spooky when he's around. Count on it.
JACKOLANTERN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Jack O’ Lanterns spray fire down a lane, doing extensive burning damage over a short distance.
JACKOLANTERN_TOOLTIP: Fires jets of flame over a short distance
JALAPENO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}This jalapeno is one spicy character by day and The Macramé Vigilante by night. You might be wondering what his secret weapon is... it's knots.
JALAPENO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Jalapenos destroy an entire lane of zombies.
JALAPENO_TOOLTIP: Destroys an entire lane of zombies

JOUST_DOWN_FOR_SERVER_STABILITY: Oops! Arena is down for maintenance! Come back in 5 to 10 minutes!

JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_4_DESCRIPTION: Place in the top ranks of your leaderboard for a promotion into a more competitive league with better rewards, and more challenging opponents.
JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_5_DESCRIPTION: Crowns from Arena matches also unlock Season prizes.

JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TOURNAMENT_ENDING: The Arena tournament is ending soon, secure your ranking!

Challengers who place in the top 3 each tournament move up a league, while the bottom 3 move down a league.
JOUST_TOURNAMENT_PLACEMENT_RESULT_FTUE: Here are 5 Gauntlets to help you get started!
JOUST_UPDATE_AVAILABLE: A new Arena update is available. Update now!
KERNELPULT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}butter immobilizes zombies

{FLAVOR}While working as an usher at the local movieplex, he saw "Fried Green Tomatoes" and found his higher calling. He packed up his husks, his kernels, his butter, and enlisted.
KERNELPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Kernel-pults fling corn kernels and butter at zombies.
KERNELPULT_PLANTFOOD: Triggers a butter storm that stuns every zombie on the lawn for a few seconds.
KERNELPULT_TOOLTIP: Flings corn kernels and butter at zombies
KIWIBEAST_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}knocks back zombies 1 tile during growth, can only grow twice

{FLAVOR}"I like to keep an even keel," says Kiwibeast. "But zombies... oooh... zombies make me so mad! And when I get mad... RARRRRRGGG!"
KIWIBEAST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Kiwibeasts emit damaging thumps, and become bigger and more powerful the more they are hurt by zombies.
KIWIBEAST_TOOLTIP: Becomes more powerful as it takes damage
LASER_BEAN_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}After a laser eye surgery had gone horribly right, Laser Bean gained a sense of purpose and a new-found affinity for competitive staring contests.
LASER_BEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Laser Beans fire down a lane, hitting all zombies ahead of it.
LASER_BEAN_TOOLTIP: Shoots a laser that pierces through zombies
LAVAGUAVA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}erupts, damaging nearby zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates a burning lava pool in its tile
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants
 
{FLAVOR}Lava Guava frowns with barely-repressed rage. He’s trying to keep it in check. He’s trying so hard. But one day some zombie’s going to push him too far, and he can’t be held responsible for the consequences.
LAVAGUAVA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lava Guavas erupt, creating a lava pool that burns zombies.
LAVAGUAVA_TOOLTIP: Erupts and leaves behind a burning lava pool

LEVELUPQUEST_BLOOMERANG_DESC: Take a high-level Bloomerang out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_BLOOMERANG_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Bloomerang for Free!
LEVELUPQUEST_CABBAGEPULT_DESC: Take a high-level Cabbage-pult out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_CABBAGEPULT_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Cabbage-pult for Free!
LEVELUPQUEST_GENERIC_DESC: Take a high-level power plant out for a spin!

LEVELUPQUEST_KERNELPULT_DESC: Take a high-level Kernel-pult out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_KERNELPULT_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Kernel-pult for Free!
LEVELUPQUEST_PEASHOOTER_DESC: Take a high-level Peashooter out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_PEASHOOTER_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Peashooter for Free!
LEVELUPQUEST_REPEATER_DESC: Take a high-level Repeater out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_REPEATER_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Repeater for Free!
LEVELUPQUEST_SUNFLOWER_DESC: Take a high-level Sunflower out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_SUNFLOWER_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Sunflower for Free!
LEVEL_OF_THE_DAY_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: You must complete Ancient Egypt - Day 5 before you can start the event.
LIGHTNINGREED_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}This may come as a shock, but Lightning Reed has a serious passion for ham radio. His call sign is El3ctric H1ccup. You can tune in every Tuesday to hear him read the classics to elderly plants. This week: Seeds and Sensibility.
LIGHTNINGREED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lightning Reeds shoot lightning at the nearest zombie up to one lane away. The bolt will then arc and hit other zombies.
LIGHTNINGREED_PLANTFOOD: Launches a cloud that travels around the lawn, zapping zombies with lightning as it hovers over them.
LIGHTNINGREED_TOOLTIP: Zaps several chickens or zombies per strike
LILYPAD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}can also be planted under non-aquatic plants

{FLAVOR}Not many people know this, but Lily Pad absolutely loves square dancing. There he is, a circular plant gliding across the dance floor making squares. He loves how it pushes his boundaries and really makes him think outside the sphere.
LILYPAD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lily Pads let you plant non-aquatic plants on top of them.
LILYPAD_TOOLTIP: Lets you plant non-aquatic plants on top of it
LOADINGTEXT_GENERIC_RFL_1: This program has been sponsored by ZCorp.
LOADINGTEXT_GENERIC_RFL_6: Plankton's Tip: Use the Winter Melon!
LOADINGTEXT_GENERIC_RFL_7: Attempting to enter and hopefully leave...
LOADINGTEXT_NPCS_RFL_10: Fortune favors the bold, and the good-looking.
LOADINGTEXT_NPCS_RFL_2: A general calls for military service.
LOADINGTEXT_NPCS_RFL_4: A leader stays with her pack.
LOADINGTEXT_NPCS_RFL_5: Three heads average roughly to one intelligent head.
LOADINGTEXT_NPCS_RFL_6: Remains of the Graveyard Onslaught training program may be out there...
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL2_RFL_3: Witness the tiny but accurate might of Action Gargantuar!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL2_RFL_4: Plants love the soothing lullaby of Music Doll... Be wary!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL2_RFL_5: Use The Great Zucchini to turn dangerous zombies into their weakest link!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL2_RFL_6: Don't those noses look familiar? Take them out before they sniff your Sun-shrooms!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL2_RFL_8: Take advantage of Funhouse Mirror Zombies with negative Tarot Cards!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL2_RFL_9: Chilled zombies take more damage from fire damage!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_1: Tarot Cards shuffle their position at the start of the level, but the deck is the same.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_10: The Vendor Bros. will ignore buffed zombies (and each other)!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_11: A seemingly bad Card can be a blessing in disguise!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_12: Plant a Hypno-shroom or Sun Bean in front of a Grinderhead.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_13: Group a bunch of Zombies together before triggering a beneficial Tarot Card.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_14: Some Jack-in-the-Boxes are duds that explode quickly, but only summon one toy. Oops!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_15: Use Potato Chips to quickly peek at the Tarot Cards at the start of the night before things get crazy.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_18: Telling Bluebert that Pinky stole his high school crush...
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_19: Whispering to Pinky that Bluebert copied his cotton candy recipe...
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_2: Boom Balloon Flower's balloons deal bonus damage when stacked!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_3: Use Potato Chip to deal free bonus damage later on in levels!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_4: Carnie Imp Twins won't split if eaten!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_8: Destroy the Jack-in-the-Box to avoid nasty toys!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_9: Keep an open mind for Monkeys.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_FAIRYTALE_RFL_5: Mirrors have magic properties to reflect magic spells!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_1: Leave spaces in the back columns for bigger shooters.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_10: Thrown Imps tend to land in the same spots.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_11: Zombies of a world can be defeated by plants of that world.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_12: Stop or slow early zombies to give more time to generate sun.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_13: Build sun production as fast and early as you can.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_14: Replace sun producers with offensive plants later in the level.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_15: Back up barrier plants with short-range melee plants behind them.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_2: Plant sun producers early and often.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_3: Try for 2 columns of sun producers.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_4: Try to save sun for costlier but more powerful plants.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_5: Use Plant Food on anything to make room for floating Plant Foods.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_6: A plant becomes briefly invulnerable during its Plant Food effect.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_7: Don't be afraid to plant on the right half of the lawn.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_9: Try insta-kills like Chili Bean or Chomper against heavily armored zombies.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_1: Boosted plants work differently, check them out!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_10: Use Infi-nut's Plant Food ability to block those pesky Fishermen and their hooks!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_11: Magnet-shroom instantly takes out All-Stars and Chair Racers.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_12: Use Hypno-shroom on zombies with high bite damage, health, or both!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_13: Use fire plants to deal with troublesome Egg Stealers and Rock Carriers!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_14: Use cheap, spammable plants to distract MC Zom-B's microphone spin!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_15: Penny's Challenges focus on your endurance. Work out any leaks in your defense!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_16: Plant forms of fodder to block Tomb Raiser's bones.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_17: Manipulate your defense to benefit from Jurassic Marsh's tar.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_18: Certain jams can speed up or slow down zombies!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_19: Want to replay Epic Quest levels? Visit Travel Log's Tourist Trap!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_2: Vine plants share space with other plants, making them a great use for extra sun!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_20: Thymed Events usually appear during special holiday occassions!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_3: Try out different plants, you just might find a new favorite!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_4: Take advantage of minecarts to move expensive plants.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_5: Keep exploring! Progressing through Adventure will unlock Epic Quests!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_7: Plant defensive plants like Wall-nut on sewers!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_8: You never know what Portals can contain, so prepare for the worst!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_9: Place cheap plants in front of charging All-Stars to stop them!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_1: Bought an Epic Realm? Check it out in the Travel Log's Tourist Trap!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_12: Use the cannon powerup as much as you feel like it — it's free, after all!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_13: Filling out the Almanac? Try out Inzanity!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_14: Check our Discord for update announcements!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_16: Puffapple can deflect more projectiles when given Plant Food!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_17: Meteor Flower and Tar make for a deadly combo!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_2: Check out the Sandbox in Travel Log's Tourist Trap to test plants freely!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_3: Commando Zombie alternates between straight and lobbed shots.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_4: Draftodil has decreased effectivity on Assault Airspace Zombies!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_5: Beware- grounded projectiles fall into the sky in Assault Airspace!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_6: You can't make new Clouds, so make the most of what the sky gives.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_7: Saucer Squash can abduct Bulls and smaller zombies regardless of health!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_8: The Rift houses various zombies of odd appearance AND ability!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_9: The Rift can contain just about ANY zombie!
